answer.explanation: The live configuration of all four functions matches the IaC template at HEAD (memory, timeout, environment variables, roles, no reserved concurrency). The misconfigurations in the commit history were reverted before the window: the thumbnailer OUTPUT_BUCKET change (32da483, reverted by e83110e at about 21:26 UTC), and the earlier TABLE_NAME and compression/uploader OUTPUT_BUCKET changes. The thumbnailer's LastModified (21:27:30 UTC) matches that revert. Logs for 22:02:24 to 22:12:24 UTC show no error, exception, AccessDenied, NoSuchBucket or timeout entries in the uploader, thumbnailer, CRUD or compression logs. Thumbnailer invocations complete in about 90 ms using 106 MB of its 1024 MB, so there is no configuration-driven failure in this window.
